verdict.rationale: Neon's own docs include a dedicated page titled "The pgvector extension", so its Postgres directly supports a vector extension for storing embeddings and running similarity search in the same database. The pack holds only the page title, so the depth of support is unproven. missing for 10: documented details on vector column types, distance operators and similarity queries, index types (HNSW/IVFFlat) and performance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can store embeddings and run vector similarity search natively without adding a separate vector database
